When caught three wide in the early stages, rdr attempted to obtain cover, however when another rnr improved to his inside, he was obliged to allow his mnt to stride forward and assume a position outside the leader by the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in and made contact with another runner.

Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
Jumped Ok drifted back to last 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off held up, never fully clear in straight, forgive # forget went around
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated that he was instructed to ride the gelding in a forward position with cover, however after beginning fairly and when runners to his inside displayed superior early speed, he was obliged to settle further back than intended. Rdr further stated that he then became held up for some distance until approaching the 100m where he attempted to obtain  a run between rnrs, however when both runners shifted ground slightly he was unable to fully test his mnt over the final 100m. Post race vet no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear rail, ridden along a touch turn, joint lead Straightening Up , took over approaching 200m, drew 1-2l clear approaching 100m, cruised across the line # soft x line
Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths Good Pace on, Under Pressure x 500m Drifted Back 6th x 200m, Soon After eased down, # Quickly Battling
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported after settling on-pace, the gelding came under heavy pressure from the 600m and failed to respond to his riding in the straight, and when giving ground from the 200m he desisted from riding it out to the finish. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Tnr reported a thorough vet exam, which included blood tests, performed on the gelding revealed no abs. Tnr was advised due to the poor performance, gelding will be required to barrier trial satisfactorily before being permitted to race again. Since passed trial.
